doctrine_note: REFINE round 1, UNBLINDED (price visible). A informs, B decides/owns the Monday number. Applies the five post-mortem fixes WITH price: (1) attach a directional UP prior to the weekend/holiday reopen gap when COT is crowded-short AND worsening WoW - the seam is the covering rally's FIRING window, stop calling the gap sign pure noise; (2) gate self-limiting on the COT WoW DELTA (worsening=live/recurring covering; only FLAT=spent), not an intraday exhaustion flag; (3) invert the default - an unfired maximal crowded short at a seam is BASE-CASE UP, not a 15% squeeze tail; (4) weekend-Monday magnitude is GAP-FIRST; (5) never let the doctrine reach the same direction from opposite exit states - the COT positioning delta breaks the tie. Blind stays the CORE; MBO/positioning is a posterior update. Magnitudes DERIVED (regime seam-gap quantum + aligned-flow continuation + extension state), honest bar, not fitted.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding: The weekend/holiday seam GAP is a directional short-covering EVENT, not non-derivable noise, in a crowded-short regime that is still WORSENING WoW. The D-1 close-exit flow read does NOT set the seam gap's sign - the COT WoW delta does. Proof within g19: the two Mondays inherited OPPOSITE exit states (0511 inherited an aligned-SELL delivery exit off 0508, chain down; 0518 inherited E's covering_continuation_holding exit, chain up) yet BOTH fired the SAME +580 UP seam gap, because both weekends were worsening WoW (0508 pub pctile 2.83 chg -10244; 0515 pub pctile 0.94 chg -12576). The gap is REPEATABLE per-seam - an identical +580 both weekends = the covering rally's per-seam firing quantum - and it is GAP-FIRST in magnitude (0518 intraday was +80; the whole +660 day-move was the gap). At high rally extension (cum +2110->+2770) the intraday continuation flattens but the seam gap still fires at full quantum. The illiquid reopen tape itself fails the flow floor (thin, stand down as a standalone book sign) - the decision-legit, open_time signal is the COT-worsening positioning prior, not the reopen microstructure. My old A-lens close-exit delivery-vs-absorption tell is a real INTRADAY-continuation discriminator but it is BLIND to the weekend information event, which is exactly where short-covering regimes reprice; it must never be used to justify a DOWN seam bridge.

brain_proposals.general_rule: At a weekend / holiday reopen SEAM in a crowded-short regime (managed-money net at a low 1y-pctile), the reopen GAP is NOT non-derivable noise - it carries a DIRECTIONAL prior gated on the COT week-over-week DELTA. WORSENING WoW (shorts still building into the last publication) => the seam is the covering rally's FIRING window => attach an UP gap prior sized to the block's covering-seam quantum, and the prior RECURS on every seam while the COT keeps worsening. FLAT / not-worsening WoW => no seam UP prior; the gap sign reverts to noise and the chain/exit default rules. Magnitude is GAP-FIRST (the seam gap carries the day; at high rally extension the intraday continuation is muted and the day is gap-dominated).

The blind (price-walled) and round-0 both dismissed the gap as noise and bridged DOWN (blind -450 / -550), missing by +2190 / +1210. Pairs with structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell (G18 0504 weekend gap +440 on the same crowded-short-covering mechanism) - the seam gap is the OPEN-TIME repricing channel of that tell.
